import numpy as np
from numpy import linalg

# Test case 1: complex128 input
A_cdouble = np.array([[1., 0, 1], [0, -2., 0], [0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.cdouble)
result_cdouble = linalg.cond(A_cdouble, p='fro')
probe('cond_cdouble_dtype', float(result_cdouble.dtype.itemsize))
probe('cond_cdouble_kind', float(ord(result_cdouble.dtype.kind)))

# Test case 2: complex64 input
A_csingle = np.array([[1., 0, 1], [0, -2., 0], [0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.csingle)
result_csingle = linalg.cond(A_csingle, p=np.inf)
probe('cond_csingle_dtype', float(result_csingle.dtype.itemsize))
probe('cond_csingle_kind', float(ord(result_csingle.dtype.kind)))

# Test case 3: complex input with imaginary part
A_complex = np.array([[1., 0, 1], [0, -2., 0], [0, 0, 3.]], dtype=np.cdouble) * (1 + 1j)
result_complex = linalg.cond(A_complex, p=np.inf)
probe('cond_complex_dtype', float(result_complex.dtype.itemsize))
probe('cond_complex_kind', float(ord(result_complex.dtype.kind)))
